scope: Active MP/ME/MS retrieval text, BGE ranking, exact-prefix packing, Step2 semantics and official-aligned RQ2 provider-message construction

supersession.reason: The approved Multi-View ontology reset replaced the historical v9 semantic-memory candidate types. The encoder backend is unchanged; only the active candidate adapter and its correct fields are rebound.

active_memory_semantics.MP: target-time Current Profile View compiled from strictly-past user statements; a profile value is context, not an instruction
active_memory_semantics.ME: strictly-past Atomic Event/Experience Timeline; action-to-user-observed-outcome is one subtype, not the definition
active_memory_semantics.MS: complete strictly-past raw Session transcript with speaker roles preserved

retrieval_binding.similarity: cosine implemented as normalized-vector dot product
retrieval_binding.candidate_document: exact active CandidateRecord.content for the selected MP/MS/ME view
retrieval_binding.DG_query: exact just-appended current-round seeker utterance at each of 10 supporter-generation rounds
retrieval_binding.sort: descending cosine, exact ties by candidate_id

packing_binding.k_zero: true OFF with no resource block
packing_binding.positive_k: exact ranked prefix; realized k may be smaller only when the eligible pool itself is smaller
packing_binding.surface_cap_values: descriptive fit diagnostics only; not a selected treatment cap

step2_binding.reason_for_v2: Correct stale runtime guidance that had mislabeled MS as event/state/continuity facts and narrowed ME to action-outcome, contrary to the already-approved active ontology.

injection.QA_and_Summary: exact Step2 PAPER1_RESOURCE blocks in canonical MP,ME,MS order inside the official human-message Relevant Memory section
injection.DG: exact Step2 blocks as system messages after the official supporter system prompt and before the official 'The following dialogue happens now.' boundary; current dialogue follows the boundary

provider_request.claim_boundary: For a hosted API the client can freeze exact role/content request messages, model route and parameters, but cannot claim a hash over the provider's undisclosed internal chat-template serialization.

observed_zero_outcome_length_facts.interpretation: The historical 384-token memory cap cannot be inherited by the active complete-transcript MS view. This is a tokenizer-length fact, not an empirical failure or a reason to redefine MS.

still_pending_before_formal_generation: one shared or explicitly scoped nonbinding resource cap after calibration design review
NVIDIA endpoint/API version, streaming behavior, timeout/retry and region/connection policy in the full Generator runtime manifest
